pages.text: Right-click the village altar with an empty hand to open the $(l)temple inspector$():$(li)$(l)Left$(): whether you are a devotee here, how many devotees there are, tier and coefficient, condition.$(li)$(l)Middle$(): worshippers at a time, today's believers, your favor from here today, the daily estimate, today's offering, and your while-away record.$(li)$(l)Right$(): what is missing, such as not being a devotee or low condition.

The bottom row shows your $(l)offering slots$() in this village: which relics are there and how many slots are free. Press Take to get one back.$(br2)$(l)Highlight$() marks the altar and prayer spots in the world for 10 seconds, as a guide only.$(br2)$(l)Stop devotion here$() ends your devotion.
